# The Title V

> Book direct for seven nights or longer in Bright or Cozy, two individual one-bedroom apartments at The Title V residence in Rawai, Phuket, Thailand. The combined option uses these same two adjacent apartments. A local agent welcomes guests.

## Apartments
- [Title V New & Bright 1BR at Rawai Beach](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/stays/bright-1br-rawai-beach/): maximum 2 adults + 2 children (up to 14), 1 bedroom(s), 1 bathroom(s), 37 square metres. A separate bedroom, a sunlit living room, and your own balcony. Settle into an easy Rawai routine, with the pools just downstairs.
  Public Airbnb source: https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/622135535519576635
- [Title V New & Cozy 1BR at Rawai Beach](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/stays/cozy-1br-rawai-beach/): maximum 2 adults + 2 children (up to 14), 1 bedroom(s), 1 bathroom(s), 37 square metres. Warm interiors, a garden-facing balcony, and a separate queen bedroom. A comfortable base for beach days, quiet evenings, and longer stays.
  Public Airbnb source: https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/922904332708842126
- [Two Adjacent 1BR Apartments in Title V Rawai](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/stays/two-adjacent-apartments-title-v-rawai/): maximum 4 adults + 4 children (up to 14), 2 bedroom(s), 2 bathroom(s), 74 square metres. Book Bright and Cozy together: two adjacent apartments, two kitchens, two bathrooms, and the freedom to keep your own rhythm.
  Public Airbnb source: https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/926800271304117606
Children must be aged 14 or under; guests aged 15+ count as adults. Each apartment has one queen bed and one sofa bed. Per-apartment capacity always applies, including when booking the pair.

## Booking and pricing
- [Availability and estimate calculator](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/book/): Airbnb calendar availability is indicative and may be delayed. An enquiry does not reserve dates.
- [Rates](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/rates/): Per-apartment THB/night: May–September 1,000; April and October 1,300; March and November 2,000; December 1–22 and February 3,300; festive nights December 23–January 12 at 4,500; January peak nights January 13–31 at 4,000. Date endpoints are inclusive occupied nights and recur annually. Base rate includes 2 guests per apartment, 4 for both. Each additional child beyond that count: THB300/night.
- Accommodation discounts: 10% for 7–27 nights; 20% from 28 nights; not cumulative. Extra-guest and cleaning fees are not discounted. Online estimates support 7–180 nights.
- Stay total includes discounted accommodation, extra-guest charges and cleaning: THB1,500 per apartment per stay; THB3,000 for both.
- Refundable deposit is separate: THB10,000 per booking up to 30 nights; THB20,000 for 31+ nights, also for the pair. Return arrangements and any documented deductions are agreed in writing.
- Metered utilities are separate from the stay estimate: water THB55/m³; electricity THB6/kWh.
- [Booking details](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/booking-terms/): Our booking team confirms availability, the final offer, payment and cancellation terms. No payment is taken here.
- [Contact](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/contact/): WhatsApp +7 913 909 8949. Guests choose whether to send a prepared request.

## Arrival and house rules
A local agent meets and greets guests and handles the apartment handover. Check-in from 15:00; check-out by 12:00, Phuket time. Early check-in or late check-out can be negotiated, subject to availability, and may cost extra. No pets. No smoking. Keep noise low, respect neighbours and follow all condominium rules.

## Residence and location
- [The residence](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/residence/): Shared pools, gardens, gym, sauna/steam room, coworking, children's facilities and parking.
- [Map and nearby places](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/location/): The Title V (Rawai-Phuket), 555 Wiset Road, Rawai, Phuket 83130. Use the Title V map pin; other phases have similar names.
The apartments are within the residence, near Rawai waterfront, not on the sand. Rawai is known for boats, seafood and island departures. Nai Harn and Ya Nui are separate swimming-beach outings, subject to local conditions. The two apartments have separate entrances and no internal connecting door.

## Local guides and rental comparisons
The competitor comparison guides discuss other Title residences and areas. This website offers only Bright and Cozy at The Title V in Rawai; it does not offer apartments in the competing developments.
- [Your first days in Rawai](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/guides/rawai-neighborhood-guide/): Seafood by the water, a stocked fridge and a beach day nearby. Start with the places you’ll use most.
- [Nai Harn and Ya Nui: choose your beach](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/guides/nai-harn-and-ya-nui-beaches/): A wide sandy bay or a small cove? Both are a short drive from Rawai, and each is worth an unhurried visit.
- [Monthly stays in Rawai](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/guides/long-stays-in-rawai/): Furnished apartments, discounts from 28 nights and the costs to budget for a month in Rawai.
- [Work from Rawai](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/guides/work-from-phuket/): See the real desks, the original Cozy connection test and the everyday setup for working from Rawai.
- [Rawai with children](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/guides/phuket-with-children/): Sleeping arrangements, children’s ages, everyday costs and small outings for a family stay in Rawai.
- [Phuket Airport to Rawai: taxi or bus?](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/guides/phuket-airport-to-rawai/): A direct car for an easy arrival, or the ฿100 coastal bus. Here are the fares, pickup points and departures.
- [Getting around southern Phuket](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/guides/getting-around-south-phuket/): Plan Rawai without a scooter: local errands, booked car rides, beach outings and the coastal bus.
- [Where to eat, get coffee and buy groceries](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/guides/rawai-food-and-markets/): A few useful starting points for breakfast, a stocked fridge and dinner by the sea.
- [A slow week in Rawai](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/guides/a-slow-week-in-rawai/): A loose plan with beaches, good food and enough room to do very little.
- [Sunset at Promthep Cape](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/guides/promthep-cape-sunset/): An open sea horizon and one of Phuket’s classic evening views, close to Rawai.
- [A rainy day in Rawai](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/guides/phuket-rainy-day-guide/): Coffee, a massage, a museum or a quiet day at home. Keep a few easy options ready.
- [Travel together, with a home each](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/guides/two-apartments-for-family-and-friends/): Plan sleeping arrangements, shared outings and separate arrivals for a trip in Bright and Cozy.
- [Dinner at Rawai Seafood Market](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/guides/rawai-seafood-market/): Choose fresh seafood, have it cooked nearby and settle in for a waterfront dinner.
- [A longtail day from Rawai](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/guides/island-trips-from-rawai/): Bon Island and Coral Island are close enough for a day out. Choose a calm day and agree the whole trip before leaving.
- [A massage at Kim’s in Rawai](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/guides/rawai-massage-and-wellness/): Kim’s has a branch on Rawai Beach Road, handy for a massage followed by dinner on the waterfront.
- [A family afternoon at Rawai Park](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/guides/rawai-park-with-children/): Water slides, a kids club and playgrounds close to Rawai’s waterfront. Bring swimwear and socks.
- [Schools and kindergartens near Rawai](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/guides/rawai-schools-and-kindergartens/): Start with these local options, then arrange a visit and check places for your dates.
- [Banks, ATMs and cash in Rawai](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/guides/rawai-banks-and-atms/): Named places for a cash withdrawal, bank visit or currency exchange, with map links to save.
- [Phuket through the seasons](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/guides/phuket-seasons/): Drier months, tropical showers and changing seas. Choose the time of year that suits your kind of holiday.
- [Phuket festivals & night markets](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/guides/phuket-festivals-and-night-markets/): Sunday walks in Old Town, dinner among the stalls and festivals worth planning an evening around.
- [The Title Rawai phases 1–2, III or V?](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/guides/the-title-rawai-phases-comparison/): Understand the phase names, compare a real apartment and choose the Rawai stay that fits your dates and group.
- [The Title Cielo or The Title V in Rawai?](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/guides/title-cielo-vs-title-v-rawai/): Compare Cielo’s published project details with a specific Title V stay, from the arrival location to the apartment you will actually use.
- [The Title Halo Nai Yang or The Title V Rawai?](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/guides/title-halo-nai-yang-vs-title-v-rawai/): An airport-area beach base or a stay on Phuket’s southern coast? Choose around the places you will return to each day.
- [The Title Legendary Bang Tao or The Title V Rawai?](https://stay.the-title-v.workers.dev/guides/title-legendary-bang-tao-vs-title-v-rawai/): Compare the area and the space: a choice of Legendary layouts in Bang Tao, or one of our one-bedroom apartments and adjacent pair in Rawai.
